config.emi.tooltip.info.open_info: Opens the Item Info screen for the hovered stack: how to get it, what it is used for and its details.
config.emi.tooltip.info.tooltip_hint: Adds a line with the Item Info key to item tooltips.
config.emi.tooltip.info.example_stacks: How many example stacks the Item Info screen shows next to each recipe category (as many as fit).
config.emi.tooltip.info.show_no_source:
Shows "No known source" for items that no recipe, loot table or other source in EMI produces.
Useful for pack developers.
config.emi.tooltip.info.show_advancement: Lists the advancements whose icon is the item in the Item Info screen, with their progress. Hidden advancements only show once you completed them.
screen.emi_info.title: Item Info: %s
emi_info.empty: EMI knows nothing about this stack.
emi_info.no_source: Nothing EMI knows of (recipes, loot, world generation, trades...) produces this. It may only be available in creative mode, through commands or from a source no mod tells EMI about.
emi_info.tooltip.not_a_source: Only turns this item into itself (not a source)
